integrity: A written complete infinite-domain proof is supplied; a standalone exact integer verifier checks many finite cases but does not provide independent mathematical certification. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification restricted to A={0,1,a,a+d} for a>=4 and d=2 or 3. The d=3 pre-stabilization cardinalities are not classified in a closed form. General arbitrary-set calculations and eventual fringes are already present in prior literature; novel statements concern sharp particular-family thresholds, explicit full deficit sets and genus, and d=2 all-h cardinalities. Older unindexed sources may cover implicit specializations.
title: Sharp stabilization and exact deficits of four-point near-paired sumsets
